production.canonicalMetadataSource: Authenticated project and D1 captures in the successful trusted-main workflow; not an independent connector resource GET.

limits: Node controls execute actual engine/view/safety/event-bridge sources in disposable DOM fixtures; only the zero-delay yield is settled as a microtask.

Browser controls use real Keeper and generated EPUBs with actual ZIP/XML inspection and hashing. A test wrapper holds result delivery before the engine captures the inspection service; actual client responses come from intercepted disposable APIs.
All publication content and admin APIs are disposable fixtures; no upload action, live catalog/provider write or production credential/CAPTCHA acceptance is claimed.
Logical cancellation discards results; local ZIP/XML work already running is not forcibly interrupted. Current selections run serially; this is not a global native-memory/concurrency bound.
Existing degraded behavior after a settled duplicate-lookup failure remains; backend duplicate/revision validation applies. A new selection can retry; no automatic retry loop is added.
Production captures and public HTTP are separate reads, not an atomic transaction or a guarantee against later edits.
Private baselines remain ignored and were not uploaded; the artifact contains only the sanitized report.
No new physical-device/provider acceptance or performance improvement is claimed.
